title: The silent doorbell
surface: Lin pressed the doorbell. There was no sound inside. A few seconds later, Zhou opened the door. Zhou had neither seen Lin outside nor heard his voice. How did Zhou know someone had arrived?
solution: Zhou cannot hear. The doorbell is connected to a flashing light indoors rather than a chime. Zhou saw the light flash when Lin pressed the button, so he knew someone was at the door. He did not know who the visitor was before opening it.

facts.text: The button triggers a flashing indoor light, not a sound.
Zhou saw the flashing light and knew a visitor had arrived.

unknowns: The reason for the visit is not specified.
hints: A doorbell is a way of sending a signal.
A signal does not have to be a sound.
Something lit up inside the house.
